lesson: Day58 ONNX Runtime CPU intra-op thread diagnostic
question: Does ONNX Runtime default intra-op threading sufficiently explain the Day57 QDQ S8S8 INT8 runtime-only slowdown on this machine?
claim_scope: Controlled diagnostic on one Intel i5-11400H Windows CPU with ONNX Runtime 1.19.2 CPUExecutionProvider; no universal INT8, CPU, accuracy, external-generalization, GPU, or embedded claim.

fixed_variables.input_set: the same six tracked Day55 images in the same order

same_model_across_thread_settings: ordered Top-3 equal for every image

interpretation_rule.full_support: For both batches, single-thread INT8-vs-FP32 speedup is at least 1.0 and improves by at least 2% relative to default.
interpretation_rule.partial_support: At least one batch improves INT8-vs-FP32 speedup by at least 2%, but full_support is not met.
interpretation_rule.not_supported: Neither batch improves INT8-vs-FP32 speedup by at least 2%.
interpretation_rule.note: Partial or absent support does not identify which untested kernel, graph, instruction, or conversion mechanism is responsible.

recorded_result: results/day58_benchmark_snapshot.json is the tracked quantitative snapshot; reruns in outputs/ must reproduce gates and direction, not identical milliseconds
